producer_report.summary: `athena status` now prints a `verification` line: verified jobs, verifier cost in USD, rejections caught, false positives and escapes. With nothing verified it prints `verification none yet`. The code is in the new `crates/athena-core/src/status/verification.rs`. It reuses the later-harm citation logic from `planning.rs`, which I made visible to the new module. I added the `verification` label to `STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS` and a `verification` field to `StatusView`. In `docs/spec.toml`, OLY-B-A7-04 now has a mechanism, keeps owner Apollo, and its measure ends `status: verification`. I also added an M35 row to `docs/enforcement.md` and a CHANGELOG entry. New tests: one unit test for the counts and two CLI tests for the printed line (counts and `none yet`). They pass, as do `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`. I ran the athena-core, athena-cli and xtask tests; the one failure, the enforcement-map test, is fixed and the policy tests now pass. I did not run the full-workspace `cargo test --locked`, which Athena runs.\n\nFalse positives and escapes are the best the records show. A false positive is a verifier fail overruled by the final verdict, or a final rejection whose job landed anyway. An escape is a landed job that a later request cites with a revert or fix."

open_issues: False positives are the best the records show: the verifier's own fail overruled by the final verdict, or a final rejection whose job landed. Escapes count only a later request that cites the landed job with a revert or fix. A rejection the owner overruled in some way the records do not show is not counted.

Cost is the sum of verifier invocation costs (best known lower bound) over jobs that have a verification record. I did not run mirrors.rs; it does not exist in this tree as far as I checked, and I did not add a test file.
mistakes: First enforcement.md row named the function verification_report in backticks in the mechanism column, which failed the enforcement-map test; fixed.
learnings: The enforcement map check treats every backticked name in the test columns as a test name; mentioning a function there fails every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists.
The Bash hook denies pipes to tail/grep, heredocs and redirects with substitution; use cargo -q and read the output directly.
The label check scans only status.rs, display.rs and hestia.rs for a string starting with the quoted label, so the printed line must be formatted in display.rs.
